summary: This page covers wire feeding setup steps 24-26 for the Vulcan OmniPro 220 welder, including plugging in power, using the Cold Wire Feed Switch, and troubleshooting wire feed issues, along with electric shock danger warnings.
text_content:
DANGER
PARTS MAY BE AT WELDING VOLTAGE
TO PREVENT ELECTRIC SHOCK AND DEATH:
1. Keep hands away from Wire Feed mechanism.
2. Close door before plugging in, unless using Cold Wire Feed to feed wire through to gun.
3. Do not touch Trigger while feeding wire through to gun.

24. Plug either 120VAC or 240VAC Power Cord into Power Input Socket.
Note: Plug will only fit one way.

25. Do not touch the Gun's Trigger. Plug the Power Cord into a properly grounded, GFCI protected 120VAC (20 amp rated) or 240VAC receptacle that matches the plug and turn the Power Switch ON. The circuit must be equipped with delayed action-type circuit breaker or fuses.

26. Point the Gun away from all objects. Press and hold the Cold Wire Feed Switch until the wire feeds through two inches.
The wire liner may come out with the welding wire. This is normal, just push the wire liner back into the Gun.
If the wire does not feed properly and the Spool is stationary, turn OFF and unplug the Welder and slightly tighten the Feed Tensioner clockwise before retrying.

Page 16     For technical questions, please call 1-800-444-3353.     Item 57812

Plug will only fit one way into Power Input Socket
120VAC receptacle must be 20 amp rated and GFCI protected
Circuit must be equipped with delayed action-type circuit breaker or fuses
Do not touch the Gun's Trigger while feeding wire through to gun
Keep hands away from Wire Feed mechanism
Close door before plugging in unless using Cold Wire Feed
Press and hold Cold Wire Feed Switch until wire feeds through two inches (2 inches)
If wire does not feed properly and spool is stationary, turn OFF and unplug the welder
To fix wire feed issue: slightly tighten the Feed Tensioner clockwise before retrying
Wire liner may come out with welding wire during cold feed — this is normal; push liner back into gun
